in_sanskrit.name: राम
in_sanskrit.meaning: Delight, pleasure, joy, joyful, beautiful, attractive, charming, radiant, or beloved
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ram is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama' which means 'Delight, pleasure, joy, joyful, beautiful, attractive, charming, radiant, or beloved'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is one of the avatars of Lord Vishnu, who is known for his virtues like truth, righteousness, courage, and love towards his subjects and his wife Sita. The name Ram is also considered auspicious and is widely used among Hindus as a given name.

in_marathi.name: Andesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Andesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Andesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Andh' meaning darkness or ignorance and 'As' meaning to conquer. This name signifies the one who conquers the darkness of ignorance in the mind. It is a powerful name for a boy in Hindu tradition.
